text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ahead of the Mile CS, Daiichi Ruby was 
working hard in training. I wondered if 
there was anything I could do—
choice_data_list:
(Come to think of it, during the Fan 
Appreciation Festival—)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The "Splendid Clan" must always stand 
above others and be worthy of their 
admiration...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we can hype up this upcoming Mile 
Championship just as much as a Classic 
race... Perhaps that would be of help to 
her.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "Promoting the Mile CS in a big way..."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"And you intend to do that 'as a 
Trainer.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no doubt that Daiichi Ruby's 
speed possesses a brilliance that 
captivates everyone. However, the sprint 
division inevitably draws less attention.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We'll promote it extensively there and 
draw the eyes of the world to Daiichi 
Ruby. As long as they witness her running, 
everyone will—"
choice_data_list:
Witness the brilliance of the current 
"Illustrious Family."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A new 'Illustrious Clan' that is 
different from anything before, symbolized 
by Daiichi Ruby..."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"However, why you? Your primary duty as a 
Trainer is—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To demonstrate the ultimate radiance as a 
member of the "Splendid Clan"... That is 
Daiichi Ruby's dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Making an Umamusume's dream come true— 
that is the very essence of a Trainer's 
job.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"So, what kind of plan do you have in 
mind?"
choice_data_list: I will prepare a stage worthy of you.
I will prepare a stage worthy of you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To raise its profile and elevate the 
race's standing in the public eye. I want 
to invite various heavyweights connected 
to the "Illustrious Clan." Among them—
choice_data_list: Let's invite your parents as well.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
choice_data_list: As you are now, you deserve it.
As you are now, you truly deserve it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
We will draw more public attention than 
ever before... and we must seize victory 
amidst it all.
choice_data_list: I think that'll be a ton of pressure

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, right now... With how she has 
overcome every kind of pressure up to this 
point, she should be able to turn it into 
her strength instead.
choice_data_list:
Your pride in your family is what makes 
you strong.

Your pride in your family is what gives 
you strength.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Understood. I will leave it to you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"To begin with, my permission shouldn't be 
necessary. If you've judged that it is 
possible, that is."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to ask for my decision. 
—For you are the Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with limited time, we set to work 
on promotional activities to hype up the 
"Mile Championship."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—Of course, I'd be glad to help! A feature 
on the Mile CS, right? I'll reach out to 
some acquaintances at other newspapers, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"No, as a fan of the 'Illustrious Clan,' I 
couldn't be happier. That light from back 
then has changed form and connects to the 
present..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: How wonderful. Let us hype it up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, we gathered cooperation from 
the participating Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"What's that, sounds fun! Sure, I'll give 
you a hand!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You mean we're doing the fes, right? I'm 
in, I'm in! Let's hype it up!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
As a runner in this race, I'm actually 
grateful for it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "So, what should we do?"
choice_data_list:
I'm in negotiations with a TV show right 
now—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—I checked with Mother. It seems she and 
Father are coming to watch the race 
together.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I heard from the butler. It appears you 
have successfully concluded negotiations 
with the other members of the family.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I imagine the schedule must have been 
quite grueling, however.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, they were tough negotiations, 
but... when you stand tall and face them 
head-on, everyone turns out to be 
wonderful people who respond in kind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Splendid Clan"—even if only on the 
surface, I felt I understood why she took 
such pride in it.
choice_data_list: Well, I have a meeting after this, so...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: You've changed, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Well then, until next time. The stage you 
have prepared—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—I look forward to seeing what you will 
do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our preparations for the Mile 
Championship steadily fell into place...
